pages.en:
“Fine. If that’s what you want, we’ll settle this here and now. Coming to school without your Servant—”

“I’m sorry! …Please, Tohsaka. You’re my only hope. I need your advice!”

I bear down on Tohsaka and back her against the wall.

This is not something the other students can be allowed to hear.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Fine. If that’s how you want it, we’ll settle things here and now. I can’t believe you came to school without your Servant”
“Sorry! I’m begging you! Please let me talk to you!”
I close in on Tohsaka and push her against the wall.
I can’t let the other students hear this.

pages.en:
Tohsaka stares at me, her mouth hanging open.

“Ah… s-sorry. The timing was so perfect that I lost my head.

“…Sakura is a younger student I know, and it looks like she might become involved in the Holy Grail War. I have to do something, but I can’t think of a good way, so—”
pages.mirrorMoon:
Tohsaka stares at me in complete surprise.
“Oh… I-I’m sorry. I got flustered because the timing of you being here was perfect.
…Um, Sakura is my underclassman. She might get involved in the Holy Grail War, and I don’t want that. But I can’t come up with any good ideas, so…”

pages.en:
“—Spare me the excuses. More importantly, would you please get off me?

“Homeroom is about to begin.”

“——! S-Sorry. I didn’t realize…!”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I don’t care about your excuses. Can you just let go of me?
Homeroom is going to start.”
“…! O-Oh, I’m sorry, I didn’t notice…!”

pages.ja:
慌てて遠坂から離れる。
……遅れて、いまさら頬がカアっと熱くなった。
あの遠坂を壁に押し付けるなんて、なに考えてんだ俺は……！

pages.en:
I hurriedly pull away from Tohsaka.

…Only then, absurdly late, do my cheeks begin to burn.

What was I thinking, pinning *Tohsaka* against a wall…!?
pages.mirrorMoon:
I quickly let go of Tohsaka.
…I feel my face burning.
What was I thinking, pushing Tohsaka up against the wall like that…!?

“…You need advice, don’t you? Fine. I’ll listen.”

“What—r-really, Tohsaka!?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I’m sorry. I know I’m apologizing a lot, but please hear me out. I”
“…You want to ask me something, right? All right, I’ll listen.”
“What? R-Really!?”

pages.ja:
「……あのね。聞いてあげないと死にそうな顔して、本当かはないでしょ。昼休みに屋上。話ならそこで聞くわ」
ふい、と顔を逸らして遠坂は階段を上っていく。

pages.en:
“…Honestly. You look as though you’ll die if I refuse, and you still ask whether I mean it? The roof at lunchtime. I’ll hear you there.”

Turning her face away, Tohsaka climbs the stairs.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Hey now. You look like you’re going to die if I don’t listen to you. Come up to the rooftop during lunchtime. I’ll listen then.”
Tohsaka turns and goes up the stairs.

pages.ja:
それを呆然と見上げていると、
「
ばか。急がないと遅刻するわよ」
どこか拗ねたような口調で、そんな言葉を残していった。

pages.en:
As I stand there watching her in amazement—

“—Idiot. Hurry up, or you’ll be late.”

She leaves those words behind in a strangely sulky voice.
pages.mirrorMoon:
As I look up at her in blank amazement…
“You idiot. You’ll be late if you don’t hurry.”
…Tohsaka leaves with those words.
